svg.title: CD Imperial Madrid
svg.desc: Club Deportivo Imperial Madrid (ES-1). Symmetrical two-color heraldic crest with continuous crowned shield, Puerta de Alcala, heraldic lions, Club Deportivo ribbon, eight-pointed star, and laurel branches. Independent editable groups for details and original outlined club lettering. Official colors #760025 and #F2EDE4.

g.inkscape:label: 01 | Crown and Shield — Unified Outer Shape
